mechanical_engineer.headline: Graduate scheme, a year in industry behind her
mechanical_engineer.why: A graduate mechanical CV is read for whether you can be signed off toward registration, so the development scheme and the accrediting body sit in the opening lines rather than at the bottom. The placement year does the heavy lifting: those drawings went to a shop floor, not to a marker.

mechanical_engineer.headline: Seven years, pressure equipment design
mechanical_engineer.why: Notice how much of this CV is standards. In pressure and process work the codes you have actually designed to are the qualification a hiring engineer reads for, and PD 5500 against ASME VIII is a real difference in what you can be given. The project values live inside the bullets here, which is what a mid-level CV can carry without a separate project block.

civil_engineer.headline: Eighteen years, licensed in four states

logistics_driver.headline: Twenty-four years driving, now holds the O-licence
logistics_driver.why: The senior end of a driving career is where the licence block gets shorter and the compliance detail arrives. What an operator is buying is a named Transport Manager CPC holder on their licence, an OCRS they can defend and someone who can run the infringement process - so those lead, and the years behind the wheel become the reason to believe it.
